title: A MENU PRESS NEVER ACTS IN THE RAID AFTER CHANGE PAD BUTTONS
why: Found in the cloud hunt of 2026-10-15: with CHANGE PAD BUTTONS moving an action onto A, B or MENU, the press that shut a menu went on into the raid as that action. With fire on A, A on RESUME RUN (or on ASCEND TO THIS SECTOR) fired a real shot; with dodge roll on B, B in the pause box rolled; with crouch on MENU, MENU crouched. Proven in headless Chromium through the real frame loop: fire bound to A, A on RESUME RUN, 1 shot fired; the standard buttons, 0. The menu marks a press as seen by the physical button but the raid reads the button the action is bound to, so the mark missed; the other way round, with pause moved onto B, a B in the raid opened the pause box and the next poll shut it again (holding B flickered it). Now the raid reads the marks of seen presses by action and hands them back by button, every button held while a menu has the controller is noted, and in the raid a moved action on a noted button reads as up until it is let go. The standard layout behaves exactly as before.
now: With your own controller buttons, the press that closes the pause box or ascends no longer fires, rolls or crouches in the raid.
